name: dsh-local-delegate
description: Delegate mechanical text work (translate, summarize, extract, classify, rewrite) to a local cheap model endpoint — Ollama native API or any OpenAI-compatible gateway — so the main model stops spending tokens on low-value text transformations. v0.4 adds per-project-workspace local AI involvement levels (none/light/default/high/max) with a scoped planner policy and local_worker delegation, plus SlaveAgentTeams: an opt-in mode where the master agent runs several local or cloud slave subagents in parallel (spawn/status/wait/send/interrupt) and coexists with native Agent Teams. v0.4.1 adds a composer quick level picker (next to the model / reasoning controls) with a config switch to show or hide it.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-host.mjs && node scripts/test-client.mjs && node scripts/test-levels.mjs && node scripts/test-policy.mjs && node scripts/test-slaves.mjs
